notes.title: Achievement update
notes.notes:
[h3]Preface[/h3]

Good day to you all. I've received a huge amount of feedback (game reviews, comments in discussions, and even personal messages) regarding the achievements.

I understand that the DMCA was extremely unpleasant news for you, as well as for me. So I've decided to release a big update directly related only to the achievements.

This news will be divided into 3 parts.

1) Briefly about all changes.
2) Detailed update information with examples.
3) Answers to questions you might have.

I hope you will like this update, as I spent a lot of time to make it. I am also waiting for your opinion about this update, it is really important to me. 

                                      [i]Thank you for your attention and have a good game [/i]

[h2]Short information about update [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]12[/b] types of letters from A-Z, numbers from 0-9 and symbols !, $,%,?.
[*] Added achievements consisting of 7 pictures
[*] Added achievements consisting of 14 pictures
[*] Added achievements consisting of 21 pictures
[*] Added memes ( More than 100+ pictures ) 
[*] Added memes consisting of a few pictures
[*] Removed achievements with animals
[/list]

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]

[*][b]Are you going to do same update for your other games ?[/b]

[i]Yes, more and better than this one[/i]

[*][b]Did you add new achievements?[/b]

[i]Nope, I have changed old one[/i]

[*][b]Should I unlock new achievements ?[/b]

[i]Nope, If you have unlocked them before[/i]

[*][b]You have removed or changed achievement i have used in my profile. Can i get it back?[/b]

[i]Yes, you can[/i]

[*] [b]How can I get back my achievement ?[/b]

[i]I need to know what do you have Instead of your old achievement now and I will return your old achievement to the new place[/i]

[*][b]How many achievements were changed/added ?[/b]

[i]About 1000+ achievements [/i]

[*][b]Can i still have community achievements  ?[/b]

[i]Yep, welcome ---->[/i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/806140/discussions/0/1694914736012364868/] Click[/url]

[*][b]How many DMCA or community achievements still alive ?[/b]

[i]933 DMCA achievements[/i]

[*][b]Will you change them as the previous one?[/b]

[i]More likely, I would say[/i]

[*][b]Why you didnt change all DMCA pictures in this update ?[/b]

[i]I didn't expect that update would take so long and be so large[/i]

[*] [b]How many people made this update ?[/b]

[i]Only me[/i]

[*] [b]I still have a questions. What can i do ?[/b]

[i]Please reply in comments here and I will try to answer as soon as possible[/i]
[/olist]
